descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Left for dead on a mysterious, uncharted island, every second is a brutal fight for survival. Ruthless predators stalk the shadows, ancient secrets lurk in the darkness, and the very earth beneath your feet is alive with deadly traps. With rescue a distant dream, you must confront primal forces, decode cryptic relics, and outwit deadly beasts if you hope to escape. The island's dark secrets threaten to consume you, testing your wits, courage, and sanity at every turn. Time is running out—can you unravel the island’s horrors and escape before you become just another ghost lost forever in its savage wilderness? Victory demands relentless courage, sharp instincts, and an unbreakable will to survive the ultimate nightmare.

Game Settings: The interactive scroll that appears on the cabin wall at the beginning of the game allows the player to change their gender, skin tone, and turning style (smooth or stepped).

Interaction: Hands in the game are controlled by touch controllers use them to swim, climb, grab near or distant objects, throw objects or store them in a backpack you carry, and craft tools by joining certain objects together. Point index finger (thumb down) to use interactive scroll, press buttons or unlock clasps.
